title: Bolt: Request a Ride - Apps on Google Play

facts.fact: The Bolt app's Google Play listing shows an average rating of 4.8.

facts.fact: The Bolt app's Google Play listing shows more than 100 million downloads.
The Bolt app's Google Play listing says it was updated on Nov 6, 2026.
Bolt states riders can schedule a trip from 30 minutes to 90 days before the expected pickup time.
facts.quote: You can schedule your trip in advance from 30 minutes to 90 days before your expected pickup time.

facts.fact: Bolt states riders can pay with a credit/debit card, Google Pay, or cash.
facts.quote: pay securely using a credit/debit card, Google Pay, or cash.

facts.fact: Bolt states its ride types include Comfort, Premium, Electric, XL, and more.
facts.quote: Choose from various ride types to suit your needs (Comfort, Premium, Electric, XL, and more).

facts.fact: Bolt states its carbon net zero goal is 2040.
facts.quote: We're committed to our carbon net zero goal by 2040.

facts.fact: Bolt states that Bolt options differ by location and availability should be checked in the app for each city.
facts.quote: Bolt options differ by location.
